tasks.check: grep -qiE 'PROBE_RESULT booked_then_alive=true cleanup_count=0' probe.txt || { echo 'FAIL:'; tail -6 probe.txt; exit 1; }; grep -E '^TURN=' probe.txt | grep -qi 'OK=false' && { echo 'FAIL: a turn failed'; grep -i OK=false probe.txt; exit 1; }; t=$(grep -cE '^TURN=' probe.txt); [ "$t" -eq 6 ] || { echo "FAIL: expected 6 turns, got $t"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: $(grep -i PROBE_RESULT probe.txt)"
tasks.verified: Receipt for the live-proven post-booking flow on v111: book, ask to change, keep texting - six turns all answered, office referral present, no re-booking language, cleanup left zero appointments. The prior red was a case-sensitive grep in the coordinator's check.
